title: Universal property of an exterior power
statement: Let $R$ be a commutative ring, $M,N$ be $R$-modules, and $r\geq0$. Use the exterior power $\bigwedge_R^rM$ of [def-weil-pbc-exterior-algebra]. Precomposition with $(m_1,\ldots,m_r)\mapsto m_1\wedge\cdots\wedge m_r$ is an $R$-linear bijection from $\operatorname{Hom}_R(\bigwedge_R^rM,N)$ to the $R$-module of $R$-multilinear alternating maps $M^r\to N$. Here alternating means zero on a tuple with two equal entries, and for $r=0$ the latter module consists of the choices of an element of $N$. Equivalently, every such alternating map $a$ has a unique $R$-linear extension $\widetilde a$ satisfying $\widetilde a(m_1\wedge\cdots\wedge m_r)=a(m_1,\ldots,m_r)$.
